verdict.rationale: Folk documents custom fields that add information to people and companies inside a group, plus AI-powered custom fields, which covers the custom-field half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows filtered, sorted, or shared views, or that an ops user can do this without admin involvement. missing for 10: filtered views, sorted views, shared views, evidence that non-admin ops users can self-serve field creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Custom fields are used to add additional information to people and companies inside a group.
